name: pace-dawdle
description: Pressure-clock probe for the CP1 pacing variants: sprint for 2s, stand completely still for 2.5s on the floor, then sprint again. The number that matters is how much crush-edge margin (and, with ?score=1, how much CHARGE) the pause costs — that is a direct measurement of FLEET-PLAN's 'pursuit clock too soft / no timed decisions' diagnosis. Run it against &pace=base vs &pace=hunt vs &pace=surge.
